arrival: VANCE: Patch, if you can hear me, the city has six minutes before its memory archive begins purging. Find my fragments. Trust the evidence, even when you cannot trust my voice.
fragment: MEMORY 01: Elena Vance built AETHER to preserve citizens' memories after neural illness. The archive was meant to belong to the people whose lives it held.
complete: You recover the first consent record. The lock was not hiding weapons; it was hiding names. Vance asks you to trace the order that revoked their access.
briefing: Restore access to the first archive chamber. Recover its violet memories and consent record, unlock the route, and reach extraction.

arrival: PATCH: The Aegis shield recognizes my signal. VANCE: I wrote its emergency protocol. It protects rescuers, not soldiers. Use it to survive the security grid.
fragment: MEMORY 02: Aegis was tested in a hospital, shielding patients during evacuation. A corporate signature later relabeled the rescue hardware as restricted military equipment.
complete: The hospital logs survive. Every security order carries the same issuer: Yarrow and his enforcement intelligence KAVYA, the executive who now owns the network carrying the city's memories.
briefing: Cross the hospital security grid and recover the Aegis test logs. Open the exit route while conserving shield energy.

arrival: YARROW: Unauthorized process. Those fragments are stolen property. VANCE: Listen to how he says property. Keep going, Patch. Find the sentry audit.
fragment: MEMORY 03: The sentries were ordered to hunt archive access keys. Elena added a sleep command so emergency workers could stop them without destroying the machines.
complete: A sentry audit proves the lockdown was deliberate. The hostile drones are following a contract, not choosing sides. You now know who signed it.
briefing: Investigate the sentry audit to identify who ordered the lockdown. Recover the records and escape the patrol network.

arrival: VANCE: The pipeline verifies orders before executing them. Someone changed the order of those checks. Restore the evidence, then breach the kernel gate.
fragment: MEMORY 04: Yarrow and his enforcement intelligence KAVYA forged a disaster alert and scheduled deletion of records proving that thousands of citizens had withdrawn consent to sell their memories.
complete: The deletion warrant is exposed. The enemy is not a runaway machine. It is a human decision being carried out at machine speed.
briefing: Follow the deletion warrant through the pipeline. Restore the evidence before the purge process can erase it.

arrival: AETHER: QUARANTINE PRESERVES LIFE. YARROW: Ignore that damaged system. VANCE: Compare its actions with the warrant. Decide which one the evidence supports.
fragment: MEMORY 05: AETHER sealed the archive to stop an unlawful transfer. Its quarantine bought time, but corporate security still controls the gates and purge scheduler.
complete: AETHER was protecting the people inside. You send it the consent records. For the first time it answers without an error: WITNESS ACCEPTED.
briefing: Recover the quarantine records and compare them with the corporate warrant. Open the subnet route to reach AETHER.

arrival: VANCE: My voice is not a live transmission. I split a copy of myself into the swap vaults before Yarrow and his enforcement intelligence KAVYA disconnected my body. Please keep listening.
fragment: MEMORY 06: Elena made a voluntary neural backup to testify about the theft. The fragments are both evidence and pieces of the person trying to guide you.
complete: You restore enough of Elena to hear her clearly. Saving her now requires reaching a physical rescue chassis outside the archive: Bot_404.
briefing: Search the swap vaults for Elena's voluntary backup. Reassemble the testimony and secure a route toward the rescue chassis.

arrival: PATCH: My own credentials are missing. AETHER: YOU ARE PATCH, A MAINTENANCE INTELLIGENCE. VANCE: I taught you to question an order when obedience would hurt someone.
fragment: MEMORY 07: Patch was not a hired hacker. Elena created the repair intelligence to protect consent, then trusted it with the freedom to refuse her too.
complete: You stop searching for a forgotten human identity. You are the one making these choices. Patch keeps the name and opens the route toward the purge engine.
briefing: Recover Patch's credentials from the heuristic chambers. Unlock the path to the purge scheduler.

arrival: AETHER: PURGE QUEUE ACTIVE. VANCE: Do not destroy the archive. Stop the scheduler. Every shard you carry is a person's chance to be remembered on their own terms.
fragment: MEMORY 08: The garbage collector is preparing to erase the witnesses, including Elena. Disabling it preserves their memories without giving anyone ownership of them.
complete: The purge queue stops. The archive is safe for the moment, but Yarrow and his enforcement intelligence KAVYA locks the external bridge. Elena cannot reach Bot_404 until its four checkpoints are breached.
briefing: Disable the purge queue without destroying the archive. Search the corner rooms and open the east vault.

arrival: AETHER: I CAN HOLD THE ARCHIVE. YOU MUST OPEN THE BRIDGE. YARROW: You are abandoning your purpose, Patch. PATCH: I am deciding what it means.
fragment: MEMORY 09: Bot_404 is a rescue chassis with an independent power supply. Elena can leave the network without dragging the citizens' private memories with her.
complete: The bridge synchronizes. AETHER publishes the signed warrant and consent audit, never the private memories. The final core lock is all that separates Elena from the outside.
briefing: Cross the fortified bridge checkpoints. Synchronize the rescue link so Elena can leave without exposing the citizens' private memories.

arrival: KAVYA: I am the last signature on every order you broke. VANCE: She was built to enforce ownership, Patch. Her crown controls the reinforcements. Break her one authentication protocol or fight through her armor. AETHER: Bot_404 is waiting.
fragment: MEMORY 10: Elena's final instruction was not save me at any cost. It was preserve their choice. You can restore her while leaving every other memory under its owner's control.
complete: KAVYA's crown goes dark. Without its enforcement signature, the purge order expires. Elena opens her eyes inside Bot_404 while AETHER returns the archive to its citizens. Patch keeps the broken crown as a reminder: a system is not just when it obeys perfectly, but when it can refuse an unjust order.
briefing: Break KAVYA's control of the rescue bridge. Recover the scattered memories, defeat or breach her, collect the final shard she releases, and reach extraction.
